description: This file contains a Lua script for automating window management using devilspie2. It manages window decoration and maximization status based on application name and window type, primarily intended for customizing window behavior in a Linux environment.

methods.name: get_window_type
methods.description: Retrieves the type of the current window, such as normal, dialog, etc.

methods.name: get_window_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name/title of the current window.

methods.name: get_application_name
methods.description: Gets the name of the application owning the current window.

methods.name: get_window_is_maximized
methods.description: Checks if the current window is maximized.

methods.name: undecorate_window
methods.description: Removes window decorations such as borders and title bars.
